subject: Inference economics recap + proposed funding path
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@mercurypay.com>; Samira Khan <samira.khan@mercurypay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 7 Feb 2027 13:04:00 -0500
Subject: Recap: Today’s discovery — cost levers, goals, and next steps

Alex / Samira — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap while it’s fresh and a suggested funding path so your procurement team has something concrete to react to. I’ve attached a short spreadsheet with the modeled scenarios (inference-econ-matrix.xlsx) and a one-page architecture note (redwood-quick-arch.pdf).

Key pain points you confirmed:
- High per-transaction cost for real-time fraud scoring at scale (peak 3k TPS during settlement windows).
- Latency sensitivity: 90th pct target <= 120ms for inline scoring.
- Data governance: customer PII must stay in their VPC, and audit logs retained 12 months.

Stated goals for the next 12 months:
- Reduce per-inference cost by ~55% compared to current hosted solution while meeting latency SLOs.
- Pilot in Q2 with ~50M tokens/month ingestion (inference calls + embeddings for enrichment).
- Prove end-to-end throughput during peak and collect metrics for a production commit in Q4.

Quick economics summary (see attached sheet for full breakouts):
- Option A — Hosted API + intelligent caching: estimated $13k/month for 50M tokens with prefix caching and 2x batching assumptions. Best for time-to-value, minimal infra work.
- Option B — Dedicated Reserved Pool (shared across scoring + enrichment) + quantized model: ~$8.5k/month effective cost after reserved commit amortization and 0.5x token overhead (KV cache savings). Lower unit cost but needs SRE integration.
- Option C — Private VPC deployment (on-prem gateway for PII, Redwood control plane): ~$12k/month + one-time infra onboarding. Preferred if you need isolated audit controls.

Main levers we modeled: batching window, KV/prefix cache hit rate, sequence-length assumptions (average tokens/call ~ 48), and quantization tier. Small changes to cache hit rate (e.g., 40% -> 60%) move unit cost materially.

Questions / asks for next steps:
1) Can procurement share an expected budget band for Q2 pilot (ballpark min / target / max)? Even a wide range lets us recommend a concrete configuration.
2) Are you OK with Redwood running a short 2-week proof-of-concept where we deploy a dedicated pool with simulated peak traffic? We’ll instrument cost/latency and provide a one-click rollback.
3) Please confirm the list of technical contacts we should include for access (VPN, KMS contacts) — Samira, I’m looping you given procurement.

Proposed next meeting: 30 minutes on Fri 2/11 to review the attached scenarios and pick a funding path. I’m available 10–12 EST or 15–17 EST.

Thanks — I’ll have Ben prepare a modeled cost breakdown specific to your 50M tokens and peak TPS for the follow-up.

—
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Subject: Re: Recap: Today’s discovery — cost levers, goals, and next steps

Monica — thanks for the clear summary and attachments. A couple quick clarifications from our side:
- Budget reality: procurement is leaning toward an initial cap of $6k/month for pilot (upper bound $9k if we show clear ROI in first month). That’s before any enterprise procurement term discounts.
- Compliance: the audit log retention and KMS integration are mandatory; we’d prefer VPC peering rather than moving data into a vendor-managed VPC.
- Volume: 50M tokens/month is our central scenario, but we may need to test a short spike to ~80M tokens during settlement testing.

Can Ben share a 50M token line-item showing Hosted A vs Dedicated B vs Private C so we can present to finance? Also please include a one-time onboarding estimate for Private (setup + audit support).

We’re good to meet Fri 2/11 at 10:30 EST — Samira will confirm on the calendar.

—Alex
Head of Data Products, MercuryPay

Hi Alex / Monica — attaching the requested line-item (see sheet tab "50M_breakout") and a short notes section below. Attachment: inference-econ-matrix.xlsx (updated).

Highlights (50M token baseline, avg 48 tokens/call):
- Hosted API (Option A): $12,950/mo (includes 10% assumed cache benefit and moderate batching).
- Dedicated Reserved Pool (Option B): $8,250/mo (assumes 6-month reservation at discounted rate, includes baseline autoscale).
- Private VPC Control Plane (Option C): $11,750/mo plus one-time onboarding ~ $18k (onboarding includes audit doc package and KMS integration assistance).

Assumptions called out in the workbook: cache-hit 55% in production after warmup, batching latency target preserved (90th <=120ms), model quantized to 8-bit for dedicated/private where applicable. If you need a variant with conservative cache (40%) I can produce it quickly — that increases Hosted to ~$16k and Dedicated to ~$10.5k.

Onboarding estimate for Private: $18k one-time (2 weeks eng + 3 days security review + support). If procurement needs SOW language, we can deliver a draft.

Rishi — I think you had a note on VPC peering implications for the latency path and monitoring — can you add a short paragraph for the follow-up meeting?

Thanks,

Subject: Re: 50M token line-item breakdown + onboarding estimate

Alex — quick note on VPC peering and monitoring before our Fri 2/11 sync.

- VPC peering keeps your inference data on your network path and satisfies the PII constraint you mentioned. Network hop adds ~2–4ms RTT on top of our host-to-host baseline depending on region; we model that into the 90th pct estimate.
- For the pilot we recommend enabling our KV prefix cache in an edge mode (cache lives in the dedicated pool) and instrumenting a 2-week warmup period. Expect cache-hit to ramp from ~20% to 50–60% if the scoring patterns are stable.
- Monitoring: we’ll expose token-level cost metrics, per-route latency SLOs, and audit logs (shipped to your S3 with lifecycle rules); we can provide a prebuilt Grafana dashboard.

I’ll post the short VPC peering notes to the shared HubSpot record and include the dashboard link for the demo. Looking forward to Friday — we’ll come ready with a recommended configuration that fits the $6k–9k pilot band you mentioned.

—Rishi
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
